camel_example: aliyun swas-open ListDisks --region cn-hangzhou --DiskType system --DiskIds '["d-bp14wq0149cpp2x0000","d-bp14wq0149cpp2y0000"]' --Tag.1.Key TestKey --PageSize 10 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-aek2bti7cf70000' --InstanceId 2ad1ae67295445f598017499dc0000 --PageNumber 1 --Tag.1.Value TestValue --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --version 2020-06-01 --method POST --force
description_en: Queries the information about disks in a region
description_zh: 查询指定地域下一个或多个已创建的磁盘信息
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open list-disks --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id 2ad1ae67295445f598017499dc0000 --disk-ids '["d-bp14wq0149cpp2x0000","d-bp14wq0149cpp2y0000"]' --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --disk-type system --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --resource-group-id rg-aek2bti7cf70000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDisks

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the disks
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the simple application server
parameters.help_zh: 指定的轻量应用服务器的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the disks. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 disk IDs. Separate multiple disk IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 磁盘ID。取值可以由多个磁盘ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: disk_ids

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。

最大值：100

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_zh:
磁盘列表的页码。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The disk type. Valid values:

system: system disk

data: data disk

By default, system disks and data disks are both queried
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘类型。可能值：

System：系统盘。

Data：数据盘。

默认全量查询
parameters.name: disk_type

fields.help_en: The tag key. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
fields.help_zh: 磁盘的标签键。标签键长度的取值范围：1~64。N 的取值范围：1~20
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. The tag value can be up to 64 characters in length. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
fields.help_zh: 磁盘的标签值。标签值长度的取值范围：1~64。N 的取值范围：1~20
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags that are added to the disks
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

Category.description_en:
The category of the disk. Valid values:

ESSD: enhanced SSD (ESSD) of PL0

SSD: standard SSD

CLOUD_EFFICIENCY: ultra disk
Category.description_zh:
磁盘类型，可能值：

ESSD：ESSD云盘，性能级别PL0。
SSD：SSD云盘。
CLOUD_EFFICIENCY：高效云盘

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the disk was created. The time follows the [ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html） standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreationTime.description_zh: 创建时间。时间格式以[ISO8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html）为标准，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

Device.description_en: The device name of the disk after the disk is attached to the simple application server
Device.description_zh: 磁盘挂载服务器中的设备名

DiskChargeType.description_en: The billing method of the disk

DiskType.description_en:
The disk type. Valid values:

system: system disk

data: data disk
DiskType.description_zh:
磁盘类型。可能值：

System：系统盘。
Data：数据盘

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the simple application server to which the disk is attached
InstanceId.description_zh: 磁盘对应的轻量应用服务器的实例ID

InstanceName.description_en: The name of the simple application server

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the disk belongs

Size.description_en: The size of the disk. Unit: GB

Status.description_en:
The status of the disk. Valid values:

ReIniting: The disk is being initialized.

Creating: The disk is being created.

In_use: The disk is in use.

Available: The disk can be attached.

Attaching: The disk is being attached.

Detaching: The disk is being detached
Status.description_zh:
磁盘状态。可能值：

ReIniting：初始化中。
Creating：创建中。
In_use：使用中。
Available：待挂载。
Attaching：挂载中。
Detaching：卸载中

Tags.description_en: The tags that are added to the disks

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
